features.name: Project Setup
features.description: Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind app with the PRD tech stack installed (zustand, three, R3F, drei, vaul, opencv-js, cubejs, supabase) and a passing ./init.sh
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: ./init.sh passed (npm ci, typecheck, lint, 3/3 vitest smoke tests in src/lib/stack.smoke.test.ts, next build). npm audit: 0 vulnerabilities.

features.name: Cube State Model
features.description: Typed wrapper around cubejs: apply move strings (incl. M, r, rotations), undo, read per-facelet colors for rendering. Held in a zustand store with move history and current step index
features.evidence: 2026-10-27: src/lib/cube/ (notation.ts, model.ts, store.ts, CubeStoreProvider.tsx). ./init.sh passed (typecheck, lint, 42/42 vitest incl. 38 new tests in src/lib/cube/*.test.ts(x), next build). Tests check exact sticker layouts after R and M, r = R M' = Rw, x keeps the cube solved, inverse algorithms restore solved, facelet strings round-trip with moved centers, and the store's next/back (undo/redo), applyMoves truncation and goTo.

features.name: Mobile Viewport Layout
features.description: Top 60% canvas area, bottom 40% persistent Vaul drawer with notation, stage indicator, step counter, tutorial text, and large single-thumb Next / Back buttons

features.name: 3D Cube Renderer
features.description: R3F canvas with 27 cubelets colored from the cube state store. Drei OrbitControls for touch camera rotation; animated layer turns when stepping moves

features.name: Manual Facelet Entry
features.description: Interactive 6-face grid where the user taps facelets to set colors, with validation that the result is a legal cube state. Doubles as the scanner's correction screen

features.name: Roux Solver: First Block
features.description: Generate a human-style move sequence that builds the left 1x2x3 block (FB). No Kociemba output

features.name: Roux Solver: Second Block
features.description: Build the right 1x2x3 block using only R, r, U, and M moves

features.name: Roux Solver: CMLL
features.description: Recognize the top-layer corner case and apply the matching CMLL algorithm

features.name: Roux Solver: LSE
features.description: Solve the last six edges using only U and M moves (EO, UL/UR, EP)

features.name: Move Explanations
features.description: Every move in the solve maps to a dictionary entry explaining why it is played; shown in the drawer as the user steps through

features.name: Camera Scanner
features.description: Mobile camera capture of 2-3 isometric corner photos with alignment overlay; lazy-loaded OpenCV.js corrects perspective and samples facelet colors, then hands off to Manual Facelet Entry for correction

features.name: Google Sign-In and Tutoring Sessions
features.description: Optional Google sign-in through Supabase Auth (sign-in button, /auth/callback, session refresh in src/proxy.ts) and a tutoring_sessions table (one row per guided solve) with RLS limiting rows to their owner. Done when a user can sign in with Google on production
features.evidence: 2026-10-27: Supabase project roux-tutor (ref uhswyjnzypxpdomhlxdy, us-east-1, free) created; migration supabase/migrations/20261027220000_create_tutoring_sessions.sql applied; security advisor clean. RLS checked live in a rolled-back transaction: a user sees and updates only their own rows, inserting as another user and any anon access fail with 42501. NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY set in Vercel (all environments). ./init.sh passed on Node 24 (52/52 tests, build with and without env vars; / stays static). next start: /auth/callback without or with a bad code redirects to /auth/error. Sign-in button checked at 390px light/dark, no horizontal scroll. Remaining: owner must create the Google OAuth client and enable the Google provider and redirect URLs in Supabase (docs/AUTH.md), then test sign-in on production.
